title: Much To Do About Mexico
summary:
Changes in Mexico could reshuffle regional oil flows
In terms of energy, Mexico and the United States have had a symbiotic relationship for many years. A significant portion of Mexico's crude oil production is being exported to its neighbors in the north (primarily the U.S. refiners ship refined products back to Mexico.
